Notifications

Which updates you want to receive

New booking requests

When a client sends you a booking request.

Booking status updates

When a client cancels, or a booking is marked completed.

Payment notifications

When a payment is recorded against one of your bookings.

Review notifications

When a client leaves a review after a completed booking.

Verification updates

When an administrator approves or queries your documents.

System notifications

Platform announcements and policy changes.

None of these preferences has a column in Eventora Database v1.0. The notifications table stores messages, not per-user delivery settings. These switches are frontend demo controls until a settings table is approved.

Verification

Document approval — vendor_profiles.is_verified

Verification state Verified
Profile state active
Documents CNIC on file — reviewed by an administrator

These are two independent fields. is_verified records whether an administrator approved your documents; vendor_profiles.status records whether your profile may trade. A verified vendor can still be blocked, and an unverified vendor is never publicly listed — which is why merging them into one flag would be wrong.

Privacy

What clients and the platform can see

List my business publicly

When off, your profile is hidden from the marketplace. Existing bookings are unaffected and you can still be contacted about them.

Show my address on my public page

Your city is always shown because vendors are matched to events by city. The street address is optional.

Clients only ever see contact details for bookings they have made with you. Administrators can access account records to manage the platform and resolve disputes. Like the notification switches, these have no column in Database v1.0 yet.

Account status

Deactivating is reversible — deletion is not offered

Deactivate my vendor account

Your account status is set to blocked, your listings are removed from the marketplace and you can no longer sign in. Nothing is deleted. This demo account carries 31 completed bookings, Rs. 3,420,000 in gross earnings and Rs. 342,000 of recorded commission — the platform and the clients involved need that history for accounting, so it is preserved. Any accepted booking not yet delivered must be settled with the client first.
